tags: The year ahead counted from today
Your dates only, by what you are
Three fixed fees in plain columns
features: Every tax and Companies House date is counted from today, so the visitor sees what they owe and when
Pick company, sole trader, employer or VAT and only your own dates light up
Three fixed-fee bands in plain columns, so the price is agreed before the first meeting
A fee request that remembers what you typed, so nobody fills the form in twice
name: Hale & Partners
short: An accountant's site that counts down your tax deadlines from today and quotes a fixed fee.
long: Hale & Partners reads like an annual report written for the client. The year ahead is a large calendar counted from today: pick what you are and your dates turn green, tap one and the big figure counts down. Fixed fees, a finished set of accounts and a fee request follow.
proves: The dates and the figures do the selling. Nothing else has to.
story: Built to prove a quiet site can still work: no photographs of handshakes, no stock office, just the two things an accountant is actually judged on: the dates and the numbers.
